cross_repository_integration.previous_denial: Two distinct registered detached Compiler checkouts both had branch=null and were incorrectly treated as sharing a branch.

implementation.claim_rule: Different registered worktrees conflict on overlapping paths only when both name the same attached branch. Detached worktrees have private HEADs and coexist. Same-checkout overlap and repository-wide scope remain fenced.

limits: This proof covers Environment claim coexistence and the bound canonical VM verification capability. It does not establish Forge application execution or Forge execution-receipt publication.
objective: Allow independent registered detached worktrees to hold narrow claims while preserving same-checkout and shared-branch fencing.
